name: Kuru: Latent Yin Chakra Adept III

system.description:
Bloodline Point Cost: 3

(You must have Latent Beast Master I) Beginning at 3rd level, you begin to become able to enhance jutsu without the nature release keyword. Once per turn, when you would cast a jutsu without a Nature Release keyword, increase its Save DC by +1. If you already are gaining a Bonus to Save DC as a result of a Clan or Class feature, you pick which bonus you benefit from.
